censor_rule: Within each run censor rows 23,24,60 and then every 37 rows beginning at 97 when in range; reset on the following row; censored response rows remain on the fitting axis.
decision: Confirm corrected and known-phi engines only if all cases satisfy exact binomial/TOST count bounds and 90% bootstrap/mean-bias equivalence intervals. Raw results are paired descriptive comparisons, not pass requirements. Pilot/screen are engineering evidence only. No bounds, cases, seeds or budgets may be revised after outcomes; failures remain in receipts.
design: Two alternating 4-second task epochs at onsets 6+32k, sampled at TR=1 and convolved with public SPMG1; run intercepts and six run-local DCT nuisance terms per run in high-nuisance cells.
metrics: mean absolute within-segment residual ACF at lags 1..4
null t and joint two-row F rejection at alpha .05
95% interval coverage for task_a in voxel 1
mean reported variance / empirical task_a estimator variance
noise: Independent Gaussian innovations with variance 1; continuous stationary AR noise within each run, independent run restarts after 256 burn-in draws. Censoring only affects estimator/whitener layout, not the data generator.
scope_limits: Stationary start-up is exact inside segments; continuous cross-censor covariance is still discarded
The old adaptive bias budget is retained, and the new tail-anchored R correction is not active
Negative previous qualification receipts remain binding
seed_derivation: (root + domain*10000019 + (cell+1)*1000003 + replicate*7919) mod 2147483646 + 1; uniform generator Park-Miller 48271/2147483647, Gaussian Box-Muller
simulator_controls: innovation mean/variance and AR covariance against analytic AR(1)/AR(2) theory
noiseless coefficient recovery through public fit
independent run restart and censor-mask layout
known-phi inference controls in every confirmation cell
truth: Voxel 0 task coefficients are both 0; voxel 1 task_a is 0.75, task_b is -0.25; nuisance and intercept coefficients fixed; independent replicate datasets are the sampling units.
scientific_admission: Only stationary candidate cells require all original margins in fresh confirmation; legacy comparison failures are retained and never claim admission. Screen and pilot confer no admission.
pairing: Policies and complete/censored/AR-order comparisons share each replicate innovation block; the doubled-duration case uses a distinct group. Seeds use the declared root and original seed formula with domains 31/32/33, groups 0/1.
